title: Tayammum – symbolic purification
intro: When we can’t use water, we can purify ourselves with clean earth.

learn.html: Before Salah and reciting the Qur’an, every Muslim must have wudu. But in certain justified situations, when we cannot make wudu, we make tayammum instead. Tayammum is a symbolic purification for Salah and reciting the Qur’an.

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html: …and if you find no water, then touch clean earth and wipe your faces and hands with it… <small>(Qur’an, Al-Ma’idah 5:6)</small>

items: there is only a little water and we need it for drinking
for some reason we cannot use water for wudu or ghusl

learn.html: Other reasons: the water is far away or hard to reach, or the water is not clean.

items: Make the niyyah in the heart and say A‘udhu billah and Bismillah.
Touch clean, dry earth (or something made of earth) with the palms and wipe the face once.
Touch the clean, dry earth again and wipe the arms past the elbows once – right, then left.

learn.label: Niyyah of tayammum
learn.ar: نَوَيْتُ التَّيَمُّمَ لِأَجْلِ الصَّلَاةِ وَلِرَفْعِ الْحَدَثِ تَقَرُّبًا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى
learn.tr: Nawaytut-tayammuma li-ajlis-salaati wa li-raf‘il-hadathi taqarruban ilallaahi ta‘aalaa.
learn.en: I intend to make tayammum for Salah, to remove impurity, and to come closer to Allah, the Most High.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: Tayammum is broken by everything that breaks wudu – and also when we become able to use water for wudu or ghusl.

practice.title: Tayammum in order
items: Wipe the right arm, then the left

practice.title: When may we make tayammum?
practice.prompt: Tap every correct reason, then tap Check.

options.text: We need the little water we have for drinking
We cannot use water because of illness
We are too lazy to walk to the tap
options.why: If water is near and usable, we must make wudu.

options: A symbolic purification with clean earth

questions.q: How many times do we wipe the face in tayammum?

options: Whatever breaks wudu, and being able to use water again

questions.q: Which surah tells us about tayammum?

prompts: 💬 What is tayammum, and when do we make it?
